meta: Misleading charts: every number on a chart can be right and still make you misunderstand, just by cutting the axis and picking dates cleverly.

muc.title: Real numbers, wrong idea
muc.text: A chart can get every number right and still mislead you, just by cutting the axis and picking dates cleverly.

muc.title: Axis not starting at zero
muc.text: A common trick is a vertical axis that doesn't start at zero, so a small gap looks like it grew several times over.

muc.title: Double of what
muc.text: "Doubled" sounds scary, but going from one to two people in ten thousand is still very few.

muc.title: Let AI read the chart
muc.text: Screenshot the chart, send it to a chatbot, and ask it to check the axes, dates and data source, then describe the true proportions.

muc.title: Inspect one chart
muc.text: Find a chart on social media and ask AI to point out what could mislead you.
